# Todoist API

> The Todoist API: a mostly RESTful API for tasks, projects, sections, comments, and more, plus the `/sync` endpoint that the Todoist apps use. Each page below is one section of the docs at https://developer.todoist.com/api/v1/, in Markdown.

## Docs
